name.title: Organization Name
name.description: This is your organization's display name on Scibly.

slug.title: Organization URL Slug
slug.description: This is your organization's URL namespace on Scibly.
slug.footer: Must be unique. May only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

logo.title: Organization Logo
logo.footer: Square image recommended. Accepted file types: .png, .jpg. Max file size: 2MB.
logo.uploadText: Click the logo to upload a new image.

deleteOrganization.title: Delete Organisation
deleteOrganization.description: Permanently delete your organisation, custom domain, and all associated links + their stats. This action cannot be undone - please proceed with caution.

modal.title: Delete Organisation
modal.warning: Warning: This will permanently delete your organisation, custom domains, and all associated links and their respective analytics.
modal.label1: Enter the organisation slug {slug} to continue:
modal.label2: To verify, type confirm delete organisation below:

aiConfig.title: Custom AI Models (BYOAI)
aiConfig.description: Connect your own AI endpoints for chat, search, and images.
aiConfig.chatSectionDescription: Choose the default model for new AI Creator conversations. Add custom endpoints to appear in the model picker.
aiConfig.imageSectionDescription: Select which model generates images in AI Creator. Add multiple endpoints and pick the active one.
aiConfig.defaultChatModelSciblyDescription: Managed chat model included with Scibly
aiConfig.emptyChatDescription: No custom chat endpoints yet. Scibly AI is used by default. Add your own to use local or third-party models.
aiConfig.deleteConfirmDescription: “{name}” will be removed from this organisation. Existing conversations are not affected.
aiConfig.unsupportedProvider: Only OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini endpoints are supported.
aiConfig.apiKeyEditPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep existing key
aiConfig.contextWindowHelp: Tokens this model accepts. Leave empty to assume 128,000.
aiConfig.imageProviderDefaultDescription: Managed image model for AI Creator image generation
aiConfig.imageActiveDescription: Choose which model generates images in AI Creator. Add multiple custom endpoints below, then select the active one.
aiConfig.fetchModelsEmpty: No models returned from this endpoint.
aiConfig.byoaiLockedTitle: Your own AI endpoints are included from {plan}
aiConfig.byoaiLockedDescription: Chat, search, and images run on Scibly's models and are charged to this organization's balance. Upgrade to {plan} to point them at your own endpoint and key.
aiConfig.byoaiLapsedDescription: Your own endpoints can no longer be changed. Reactivate the subscription to configure them again.
aiConfig.byoaiLockedRemovalNote: Removing an endpoint or switching back to Scibly AI stays available.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect external services to your organization — knowledge bases AI Creator notebooks can import pages from, and code hosts scibly can read.
integrations.confirmDisconnectDescription: Existing sources will remain in your notebooks, but re-sync will no longer work until you reconnect.
integrations.grantsEmpty: This connection has not been given access to anything yet.
integrations.grantsError: Couldn't load what this connection can reach.
integrations.revokedNotice: This integration was removed on the provider's side, so the connection has been removed here too. Connect again to resume.
